decisions.reason: As the flagship product closely aligned with existing agricultural crates, the firm's high absorptive capacity enables it to interpret market feedback and improve the crate.
Foldable large containers build directly on the firm's container expertise, allowing effective assimilation of results and ongoing refinement.
Rackable pallets are an extension of existing pallet knowledge and manufacturing, so the firm can absorb feedback and enhance the product line.

Although spill-retention pallets require additional environmental and safety knowledge, the firm's pallet expertise and cooperation options provide sufficient absorptive capacity to keep improving the product.
Plastic pallets with load retainers are closely related to existing pallet offerings and benefit from dedicated promotion, indicating high absorptive capacity and commitment.
